result.summary: The intersection features high-visibility continental crosswalks and basic sidewalk infrastructure in a mixed-use urban setting. However, the lack of visible pedestrian signals and the presence of wide turning radii present safety challenges for non-motorized users.

hazards.name: Lack of pedestrian signals
hazards.description: No dedicated pedestrian signal heads are visible at the intersection, requiring pedestrians to interpret vehicle signals which may not provide adequate clearance time.

hazards.name: Visual obstruction from parked vehicles
hazards.description: Vehicles parked close to the intersection on the side street may obstruct sightlines between drivers and pedestrians entering the crosswalk.
hazards.location_in_image: Left side of the image along the side street

interventions.title: Pedestrian Countdown Signals
interventions.description: Install pedestrian signal heads with countdown timers to provide clear information on remaining crossing time.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Construct bulb-outs to shorten the crossing distance, improve visibility, and slow turning vehicles.

result.summary: The intersection features a marked high-visibility crosswalk and a dedicated bike lane on a one-way street. However, a parked vehicle near the corner obstructs sightlines, and there is a lack of visible pedestrian-specific signaling.

hazards.name: Visual Obstruction from Parked Vehicle
hazards.description: A white SUV is parked immediately adjacent to the crosswalk, blocking the sightlines between approaching drivers and pedestrians waiting to cross.
hazards.location_in_image: Left side of the image, near the crosswalk entrance.

hazards.name: Lack of Pedestrian Signal
hazards.description: No dedicated pedestrian signal head is visible at this signalized intersection, which may lead to confusion about when it is safe to cross.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions (Bulb-outs)
interventions.description: Extend the sidewalk into the parking lane to shorten crossing distance and prevent vehicles from parking too close to the crosswalk, improving visibility.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Countdown Signals
interventions.description: Install pedestrian signal heads with countdown timers to provide clear information to pedestrians.

result.summary: The intersection includes essential pedestrian infrastructure such as marked crosswalks, curb ramps with tactile warnings, and pedestrian signals. However, safety is reduced by vehicles parked close to the corner which obstruct sightlines, and minor sidewalk obstructions from debris.

hazards.name: Visual Obstruction from Parked Cars
hazards.description: Vehicles parked immediately adjacent to the intersection corner block the line of sight between approaching drivers and pedestrians waiting to cross.
hazards.location_in_image: Along the curb line on both sides of the intersection.

hazards.name: Sidewalk Obstruction
hazards.description: Trash bags placed on the sidewalk near the corner store entrance create a minor physical barrier and trip hazard.
hazards.location_in_image: On the sidewalk near the utility pole at the corner.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions (Bulb-outs)
interventions.description: Extend the sidewalk into the parking lane at the intersection to shorten the crossing distance and place pedestrians in a more visible position.

interventions.title: Daylighting
interventions.description: Restrict parking within 20-30 feet of the crosswalk to ensure clear sightlines between motorists and pedestrians.

interventions.title: Leading Pedestrian Interval (LPI)
interventions.description: Adjust signal timing to provide pedestrians with a 3-7 second head start before the parallel vehicle traffic receives a green light.

result.summary: The intersection features a high-visibility zebra crosswalk and traffic signals within a residential row-house context. While basic pedestrian infrastructure like sidewalks and curb ramps are present, the environment lacks dedicated pedestrian signals and physical traffic calming measures to shorten the crossing distance.

hazards.name: Lack of pedestrian signals
hazards.description: No dedicated walk/don't-walk signals are visible, forcing pedestrians to rely on vehicle signals which may not provide adequate clearance time.

hazards.name: Unprotected crossing distance
hazards.description: Pedestrians must cross the entire width of the roadway without a median refuge or curb extensions to reduce exposure.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Countdown Signals
interventions.description: Install dedicated pedestrian signal heads with countdown timers to improve predictability and safety for people crossing.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions (Bulb-outs)
interventions.description: Extend the sidewalk at the corners to shorten the crossing distance and increase pedestrian visibility to drivers.

interventions.title: Street Trees and Greenery
interventions.description: Add street trees to provide a vertical buffer between the sidewalk and the roadway, while also improving the microclimate.
